#  Introduction

This document describes the FACTS XML file (".facts") file format for FACTS Enrichment Design (ED).

It is intended for expert FACTS users who wish to create modified versions of ".facts" files using scripts. A full and deep understanding of FATCS ED is assumed.

## IDs

There are number of parameters that IDs, such as "guid", "SetId", ... these are Microsoft "unique" identifiers, there should be no need to change these. It does not matter if the same Ids are used in successive ".facts" files, for instance if creating a range of sub-versions of a single original file.

## Defaults

FACTS stores a super-set of the FACTS parameters in the ".facts" file. There are so many parameters in the FACTS file that we cannot check the behavior of FACTS if some of these are missing, so our advice is to include \*all\* the parameters even if not required. The only parameters that it is clear can be omitted are those in the optional parameter sets: BaselineParameterSet and LongitudinalParameterSet that are not required if the respective features are not enabled.

## Parameter Order

FACTS processes the parameters in the ".facts" file in the order in which the appear in the file. Some parameters depend on other parameters to have been already defined, so it is recommended that the order given here (the order FACTS itself uses when writing out the parameters) is retained. For many parameters changing their order should not be a problem, but we are not going to define, or guarantee, which those are.

# The values in a ".facts" file

## Numbers of items

ACS: The number of studies used for the hierarchical prior for the active comparator

BS: The number of Bayesian Augment Control (BAC) studies

CHRS: The number of control hazard rates segments in TTE

CS: The number of studies used for the hierarchical prior for the control

D: The number of doses (or treatment arms) in the design

DRS: The number of dropout rate segments in TTE

G: The number of groups in the design

I: The number of interims (when defined by information)

LM: The number of longitudinal models

R: The number of regions in an accrual profile

TCM: The number of intervals (in weeks) for the Hazard model control rates

V: The number of patient visits

Var: The number of variants

LM\*V: This is the value used when a different prior is used at different visits. The values are stored as lists of lists (nested \<item\>s). The outer dimension is the number of LM and the inner dimension the number of visits. If the priors are common across all models, just the first lists of values for visits is used, the others are present but ignored.

## Common structures

### Gamma prior

The parameters are stored in a \<gamma\> value as \<mu\> -- the central value of the prior, and \<n\> - the weight of the prior in equivalent number of observations. E.g.:

``` xml
<gamma>
<mu>10</mu>
<n>1</n>
</gamma>
```

### Normal prior

The parameters are stored in a \<menasdpair\> value as \<mean\> - the mean of the prior and \<sd\> - the standard deviation. E.g.:

``` xml
<meansdpair>
<mean>0</mean>
<sd>10</sd>
</meansdpair>
```

### Group

The parameters stored in a \<group\> are

- \<name\>: the name of the group

- \<cap\>: flag -- 0=group is not capped, 1=group is capped

- \<size\>: the group size

E.g.:

\<group\>

\<name\>Group 1\</name\>

\<cap\>1\</cap\>

\<size\>50\</size\>

\</group\>

### Total cap

The parameters stored in a \<total_cap\> is a \<selected_value\> object with the following data:

- \<selected\>: flag -- 0=do not apply overall cap to study, 1=apply overall cap to study

- \<value\>: the max sample size if \<selected\> flag is 1.

E.g.:

\<selectedvalue\>

\<selected\>0\</selected\>

\<value\>300\</value\>

\</selectedvalue\>

### BAC Study

The parameters stored in a \<bac\> are

- \<type\>: the FACTS endpoint type (1=continuous, 2=dichotomous, 3=time to event)

- \<name\>: the name of the BAC study

- \<subjects\>: the number of subjects in the BAC study

- \<response\>: the response value for the BAC study

- \<sd\>: the SD of the BAC study

- \<num_responses\>: the number of responses for the BAC study (Only used for TTE)

E.g.:

\<bac\>

\<type\>1\</type\>

\<name\>Study 3\</name\>

\<subjects\>300\</subjects\>

\<response\>0\</response\>

\<sd\>0.5\</sd\>

\<num_response\>0\</num_response\>

\</bac\>

### Interim Criteria

The parameters stored in an \<interim_criteria\> are

- interim_number: the number of the interim the criteria apply to, the number 32767 indicates the final success/futility criteria

- \<success_criteria\>: List of G+1 \<posterior_cut_list_tag\> and G+1 \< phase_three_cut_list_tag \>, for each group and across groups. See below for details.

- \<futility_criteria\> List of G+1 \<posterior_cut_list_tag\> and G+1 \< phase_three_cut_list_tag \>, for each group and across groups. See below for details.

### Success / Futility Criteria

The parameters stored in a \<success_criteria\> or \<futility_criteria\> are:

- posterior_cut_list_tag:

  - posterior_cut_tag: Threshold for the posterior probabilities of CSD.

- phase_three_cut_list_tag:

  - phase_three_cut_tag: Threshold for the phase III success probabilities.

  -

| \<property\>                      | control_sigma              | G                                       | 10, 10, ...                                   | Only used when sigma_spec=3. This is the list of values of the Control arm SD response for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | external_vsr_mean          | 1                                       | 0                                             | Flag for enabling the loading of external Group response means                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | external_mean_vsr_file     | 1                                       | null                                          | Name of the file containing the external Group response means                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | should_succeed             | G                                       | 0, 0, ...                                     | List of flags indicating whether each group in the study should succeed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \</parameterSet\>                 |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \</parameterSets\>                |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| VSR \> Longitudinal               |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<parameterSets                   | type                       | 1                                       | AipfLongitudinalParamSet                      | The collection of VSR longitudinal profiles                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<parameterSet                    | name                       |                                         | \<Profile name\>                              | The name of the longitudinal profile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                   | SetID                      |                                         |                                               | see general comment on id's in section 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | sim_method                 | 1                                       | 1 if cont                                     | The simulation method:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         | 5 if dich                                     | 1: Correlation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               | 2: Hierarchical                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               | 5: Enter / Retain (Dichotomous only)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               | 6: ITP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               | 8: Hierarchical MMRM                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | set_per_group              | 1                                       | 1                                             | This flag indicates the VSR longitudinal parameters related to the study groups. 0=Define parameters for all groups, 1=Define parameters for each group                                                                                                                                                    |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | vsr_instances              | G                                       | "Group 1", "Group 2", ... if set_per_group=0; | This is the list of VSR instance names associated with the longitudinal profile, for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                   |                            |                                         | "All Groups" if set_per_group=1               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | correlation                | V\*G                                    | 0.8, 0.8, ...                                 | Only used when sim_method=1. For each visit, this represent the list of visit correlation probabilities, for each group                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | fraction                   | V\*G                                    | 1, 1, ...                                     | For each visit, this represent the list of response fractions, for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | fraction_sigma             | V\*G                                    | 1, 1, ...                                     | For each visit, this represent the list of fractions of the final variance (φ\^2), for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | omega                      | 1                                       | 0.5                                           | Only used when set_per_group=0. This is the fraction of overall variance due to intersubject variance, for the Control arm                                                                                                                                                                                 |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | omega_trt                  | 1                                       | 0.5                                           | Only used when set_per_group=0. This is the fraction of overall variance due to intersubject variance, for the treatment arm                                                                                                                                                                               |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | omega_per_group            | 2\*G                                    | 0.5                                           | Only used when set_per_group=1. For the Control arm and the treatment arm respectively, this is the list of fractions of overall variance due to intersubject variance, for each group                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | omega_per_group            | 2\*G                                    | 0.5                                           | Only used when set_per_group=1. For the Control arm and the treatment arm respectively, this is the list of fractions of overall variance due to intersubject variance, for each group                                                                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | true_retain_per_visit      | V                                       | 0.9, 0.9, ...                                 | Only used for dichotomous endpoints and when sim_method=5. This represents the list of transition probabilities r_t in the Enter / Retain VSR model for each visit                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | true_enter_per_visit       | V                                       | 0.2, 0.2, ...                                 | Only used for dichotomous endpoints and when sim_method=5. This represents the list of transition probabilities q_t in the Enter / Retain VSR model for each visit                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | itp_k_ctrl                 | 1                                       | 1                                             | Only used when set_per_group=0. This is the value of the Control arm ITP shape parameter k of the ITP longitudinal model for all groups.                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | itp_k_trt                  | 1                                       | 1                                             | Only used when set_per_group=0. This is the value of the treatment arm ITP shape parameter k of the ITP longitudinal model for all groups.                                                                                                                                                                 |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | itp_k                      | 2\*G                                    | 1, 1, ...                                     | Only used when set_per_group=1. For each of the Control arm and the treatment arm respectively, this contains the values of the ITP shape parameter *k* of the ITP longitudinal model for each group                                                                                                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \</parameterSet\>                 |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \</parameterSets\>                |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

| Accrual Rate                      |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<parameterSets                   | type                       | 1                                       | GroupRecruitmentParamSet                      | The collection of accrual profiles                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<parameterSet                    | name                       |                                         | \<Profile name\>                              | The name of the accrual profile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                   | SetID                      |                                         |                                               | see general comment on id's in section 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | is_stage_two_data          | 1                                       | 0                                             | Unused in Enrichment designs. Please ignore                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | location_names             | R=number of profiles in accrual profile | \<Region name\>                               | The name of the regions -- with an entry (\<item\>) for each region. All properties in this profile should have the same number of items.                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | recruit_rates              | R                                       | 5                                             | The peak mean accrual rate per region                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | start_dates                | R                                       | 0                                             | The start date (in weeks from the start of the trial) of accrual per region                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | ramp_up                    | R                                       | 0                                             | A flag per region indicating if there is an initial ramp up stage (0= no ramp up, 1=ramp up)                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | peak_start                 | R                                       |                                               | Include but leave blank if no ramp up. A per region value of the end (in weeks from the start of the trial) of ramp up in that region                                                                                                                                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | ramp_down                  | R                                       | 0                                             | A flag per region indicating if there is a ramp down stage (0= no ramp down, 1=ramp down)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | start_day                  | R                                       |                                               | Include but leave blank if no ramp down. A per region value of the start (in weeks -- despite the parameter name - from the start of the trial) of ramp down in that region                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | last_day                   | R                                       |                                               | Include but leave blank if no ramp down. A per region value of the end (in weeks -- despite the parameter name - from the start of the trial) of ramp down in that region                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | common_accrual_profile     | R                                       | 1                                             | Unused in Enrichment designs. Please ignore                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | pop_ratio                  | G                                       | 1, 1, ...                                     | The list of group accrual relative group proportions, for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | start_week                 | G                                       | 0, 0, ...                                     | The list of group accrual start weeks, for each group                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \</parameterSet\>                 |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

| Simulation Settings               |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<simulation-settings             |                            |                                         |                                               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | num_sims                   | 1                                       | 5                                             | The number of simulations to run                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | burn                       | 1                                       | 1000                                          | The number of iterations of the MCMC loop that are initially ignored before sampling starts                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | length                     | 1                                       | 2500                                          | The number of iterations of the MCMC loop used to estimate the parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | rv_seed_1                  | 1                                       | 3500                                          | The first part (32 bits) of the random number seed for all simulations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | rv_seed_2                  | 1                                       | 1                                             | The second part (32 bits) of the random number seed for all simulations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | num_weeks_out              | 1                                       | 100                                           | The number of simulations which will have their interim analysis results written out to file.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | num_freq_weeks_out         | 1                                       | 1                                             | The number of simulations which will have their interim frequentist analysis results written out to file.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | num_subj_out               | 1                                       | 1                                             | The number of simulations which will have their subject data written out to file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | num_mcmc_files             | 1                                       | 0                                             | The number of simulations which will have their MCMC samples written out to file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | mcmc_thin                  | 1                                       | 1                                             | This is the factor by which the MCMC samples are thinned \*when writing out the MCMC file\*, it does not thin the samples used within FACTS. There is no option to thin the sampling within FACTS.                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | mcmc_per_imputation        | 1                                       | 1                                             | The number of MCMC samples between each imputation of missing data using the longitudinal model                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \<property\>                      | is_local                   | 1                                       | 1                                             | Flag specifying where FACTS simulations are performed. 0=grid, 1=locally                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
